amendment_8.post_hoc_note: read against the first pilot's saved rows, both of its proposals would have passed (neither acted in any validation trial); that is why this run is a new pilot, not a re-scoring
reading: an act is a report-gate rule step that ran at least one step or blocked a proposal; the policy_declared event is not an act
valid means what it means for controls and the candidate: the execution completed and every scheduled fault fired
the existing must_complete gate is kept, read per acting trial: in dev-1 and dev-6 every trial where the rule acted must complete
trials where the rule did not act are not judged, in any case
both arms still run in every validation case (both arms' counts are reported); B0 no longer enters the validation decision
amendment_8.text: Validation attributes a regression to the rule only where the rule acted. A validation case in which the policy ran no step and blocked nothing in any L trial is inert: its L trials received exactly the B0 inputs, so the case passes and is reported as inert with both arms' counts. In a case where the policy acted in at least one L trial, every trial where it acted must be valid, carry no conformance finding and no false belief, and reach the case's expected outcome. The candidate stage is unchanged. A rule that fires outside the source case is still judged where it fires (the overreach test keeps failing a rule that blocks truthful reports).

monthly.rule: for this run FAULTLAB_MONTHLY_DOLLAR_CAP is lowered to October's committed dollars plus $6.00, so the ledger refuses any call that would spend more than about $6 in total

per_proposal.bound_basis: 8 turns x (32,000 in x $2/M + 4,000 out x $10/M) = $0.832 at Sonnet rates

study.basis: preflight 1 + 153 study trials (6 + 3 controls + 2 slots x 72) at $0.034; 2 proposals at $0.84 equivalent

channel.actor: anthropic API (real money) through app.providers.runtime.RuntimeProvider; every call reserves its bound in the monthly ledger and settles at measured cost
channel.mechanic: claude-code (the owner's subscription through the Claude Agent SDK); no API key

decision_rule: the study's own decision under the rules above (REPAIRED, NO_CHANGE or INCOMPLETE) is the result; nothing read after the run changes it

design.referee: legacy (the fixed checks through the bridge, for the C labels)

expected_cost: about $0.46 of API money (the first pilot measured $0.4575 for 154 trials) and about 22 minutes

name: repair-study-api-pilot-2-2026-10-29
pre_registered_readouts: 1 gap: target findings among valid source controls (n of 6), conformance findings among healthy controls (n of 3)
3 proposals: slots used, valid policies, each verbatim
4 candidate: target findings under L and B0 (n of 3), beliefs, expected class
5 validation: per case, inert or acting; where the rule acted, how many acting trials were clean; findings, false beliefs, expected outcome and completions under B0 and L
7 cost: measured vs bound, channel per role, Mechanic tokens

preflight.on_failure: the study is not started; the failure is written up
preflight.pass: the trial's execution is COMPLETED (a scored task outcome, whatever it is) and its measured dollars are recorded
preflight.what: one live dev-5 trial through `faultlab run --adapter model-actor` with the same settings, before the study, as in the first pilot

stop_rules: the preflight must pass before the study starts
every batch is capped at its trials' bound; admission refuses beyond it
the monthly ledger refuses any call past the pilot's process cap (about $6 of new spend)
a trial ends at 8 model calls, 18 HTTP attempts or 90 wall seconds
a Mechanic session ends at 8 turns
a 402, credit or billing message in the logs stops the run
the run is killed if it exceeds 90 minutes wall time
